title: Battle of Mbororé
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Mbororé", at revision 1370269258, opens: "The Battle of Mbororé, which occurred on 11 March 1641, was a conflict between the Guaraníes inhabiting the Jesuit Missions and the bandeirantes, Portuguese explorers and slavers based in São Paulo and allied with the Tupíes. The battle is site is near Cerro Mbororé, Panambí, in the province of Misiones, Argentina. The battle ended in a Guarani victory. It took place at the beginning of the Portuguese Restoration War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q932519, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1641 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
